angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 556,560 km at 137.74 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.2601 +/- 0.0111 mas (same row, RUWE 0.85): 137.74 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.8 +/- 0.011 solar radii from Mancini et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1272 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract): 556,560 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.828 +/- 0.037 solar masses from Mancini et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1272 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4985 +/- 40 K from Mancini et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1272 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Mancini et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1272 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1272.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.550, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1272 (pscomppars): spectral type K2 V - K3 V, from Mancini et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-1272: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1272 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.1 dex, from Mancini et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1272 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.46547, from Mancini et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1272 (pscomppars): age 7 Gyr, from Mancini et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1272 (pscomppars): rotation period 28.3 d, from MacDougall et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....164...97M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1272 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 1.2 km/s, from Mancini et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.8 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.839. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
